schema = (
    StructType()
    .add("struct", StructType().add("x", StringType()).add("x", IntegerType()))
    .add(
        "struct2",
        StructType()
        .add("a", IntegerType())
        .add("x", IntegerType())
        .add("x", StringType()),
    )
)
root_cause: Duplicate field names 'x' within StructType definitions cause SQL errors in Snowflake SCOS
explanation: The schema contains duplicate field names 'x' within both nested struct definitions, which will cause a 'Duplicate field name' SQL error when used with Snowflake SCOS.
fix: Rename duplicate fields to have unique names within each struct, e.g., change the second 'x' fields to 'x2' or another unique identifier: .add('x', StringType()).add('x2', IntegerType())
